sections.title: Work requiring attention
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,attention,latest_progress from action_queue where attention<>'scheduled' or latest_progress='blocked' order by due_on

sections.title: Weak scores and assigned work
sections.sql: select survey,question,factor,favorable_pct,open_actions from priorities order by closed_on desc,question

sections.title: Survey comparisons
sections.sql: select survey,question,favorable_pct,change_points,state from score_changes order by closed_on,survey,question

sections.title: Completed actions and later scores
sections.note: A later score is a comparison, not proof that an action caused the change.
sections.sql: select code,question,baseline_pct,followup_pct,target_pct,outcome from outcome_review order by code

sections.title: Review work
sections.sql: select * from compliance_checks order by record,rule

sections.title: Withheld scores
sections.sql: select survey,question,state from scorecard where state<>'released' order by survey,question
